intro.zh: 旧矿道的警示牌仍在。三人停在入口，先确认了退路。
intro.en: The warning sign still stands outside the old mine. The three stop at the entrance and check their way back.

outro.zh: 第一块碎晶离开了黑暗。三人没有追逐深处的回声，沿原路返回。
outro.en: The first crystal fragment leaves the darkness. The three ignore the deeper echo and return along their marked route.
